🚨 Hiring: Network Engineer
📍 Location: Remote
⏳ Duration: 3+ Months
🛂 Work Authorization: GC/USC Only
🔗 LinkedIn: Required
🎯 Interview: 2 Rounds

💬 Spanish Fluency

We are looking for a Network Engineer with strong experience in Network Security, Firewall Governance, Operations, and Remediation.

🔑 Must-Have Skills
• 5+ years of experience in Network Security
• Strong hands-on experience with Firewall Governance and Operations
• Experience managing and reviewing firewall rule bases — Palo Alto, Check Point, Cisco ASA/Firepower, Fortinet
• Strong knowledge of Firewall Policies, Rule Lifecycle Management, and Access Governance
• Experience with Firewall Rule Reviews, Recertification, Cleanup, and Optimization
• Experience supporting Audit Remediation, evidence collection, documentation, and issue tracking
• Ability to analyze firewall rules for compliance, security risks, and operational effectiveness
• Experience working with Audit, Risk, Regulatory, and Compliance teams
• Knowledge of automation, scripting, or AI-assisted security operations is a plus
• Experience with ServiceNow or Jira
• Proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio
• Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and communication skills

⭐ Plus
• Spanish fluency
• Experience with network security automation and scripting

📩 Interested candidates: Please share your updated resume at ashish.kumar@sourceinfotech.com

#Hiring #NetworkEngineer #NetworkSecurity #Firewall #PaloAlto #CheckPoint #Fortinet #Cisco #Cybersecurity #FirewallGovernance #SecurityEngineer #RemoteJobs #TechJobs
comment: Firewall governance roles often reveal issues beyond rule cleanup—ownership clarity, stale application dependencies, and change processes usually determine whether remediation efforts actually improve security.
